answer: Each agent identity is accepted only with a zero-knowledge attestation of a TPM/SGX enclave running the prescribed model, whose measurement is committed in the shale state tree and relayed by the bridge to a consensus contract. The signal circuit rejects reused measurements and requires a fresh VDF. Forging identities therefore requires physically provisioning distinct certified silicon and recomputing proofs; registration bonds follow an O(N^2) quadratic curve, with fraud causing irreversible slashing.
